desc: In-progress roof transition at a red-brick chimney, showing individual galvanized step-flashing pieces staged course by course with gray asphalt shingles before the masonry counterflashing is completed.
reuse_notes: Use for chimney step-flashing sequencing, roof-to-masonry transition planning, asphalt-shingle repairs, and weather-management articles. It depicts an intentionally in-progress generic installation stage, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for evaluating chimney condition, roof slope, counterflashing, code, or manufacturer-specific requirements.
